source: Sephiroth's forms on Cloud's ability IDs (Create a Character System 3.6): your playable Sephiroth (Cloud's rows, including the prologue's Cloud in Zack's SOLDIER outfit) has five forms on the forms menu (hold Triangle in battle, pick one with up / down, let go): NORMAL (Battle00), WINGED (Battle02 = the transformed Sephiroth's Battle00), FLYING (Battle03 = his Battle01 wing moves, then his Battle00; it also comes by itself after Heartless Angel), KH2 (Battle04: his Kingdom Hearts II moves) and BIZARRO (Battle05: he becomes Bizarro Sephiroth, with Bizarro's attacks as his commands and in place of his weapon abilities, his moves made of Bizarro's animations, Bizarro's conjured sword in his sword attacks, super armor; it lasts 60 s, then 30 s before it can be chosen again). His limits are Cloud's (level 1 Octaslash, 2 Heartless Angel, 3 Meteor: they unlock like Cloud's), the abilities Cloud's weapons give are his moves and switch with the form (weapon_abilities), and each form has its own ATB commands. His rows load the transformed Sephiroth's and Bizarro's effects (pack_assets) and the Fire/Blizzard/Thunder/Aero ability resources (preload). Goes with FullyPlayableSephirothDataAssets_P (his abilities, limits, damage and rows) and SephirothForms_P (the built moves). Field sets (Neutral00, Neutral20, Emotion00, Facial00): his own first, then Cloud's. Summons: Cloud's summon cast (B_MagSummon01) in every form but BIZARRO.
